select od.name as name, sum(od.number) as number from order_detail od inner join orders o on od.order_id = o.id where o.status = 5 and o.order_time >= #{begin} and o.order_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by od.name order by number desc limit 10
select b.status as status, count(b.id) as batchCount, coalesce(sum(b.stock * p.price), 0) as amount from product_batch b inner join product p on b.product_id = p.id group by b.status
